title: DIY mass spectrometer measures potassium in dietary salt substitute
summary: Ben Krasnow of Applied Science builds and operates a simple mass spectrometer, using it to measure potassium isotopes in a salt substitute. He explains the design choices and the theory behind it.
why: Recommended as an expert-made DIY build that explains why the apparatus is designed as it is, though one commenter notes a missing baseline run.

quote.text: he tries to explain why it's built the way it is and give you a good basis of the theory of operation.
